sal.basis: Egyptian pay is quoted monthly, and often net, so always confirm gross or net. Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, ~8 yrs, Cairo, at a bank, telecom, listed group or multinational: about 40,000-65,000 EGP gross a month in 2026, after the March 2024 devaluation and the catch-up raises since (background estimate, not verified live this run; see EG.sources.md). Chosen 50,000 EGP gross. f = 50,000 / 26,000 = 1.923, so Noura's 26,000 becomes ~50,000 EGP now and 34,000 becomes ~65,400 EGP expected. Banks and large firms often add bonuses and profit share worth several months' pay, which this monthly figure leaves out.

autoText.en: Egyptian citizens, including dual nationals, can work in Egypt without a work permit.
autoText.ar: يمكن للمواطنين المصريين، بمن فيهم مزدوجو الجنسية، العمل في مصر دون تصريح عمل.
autoText.fr: Les citoyens égyptiens, y compris les binationaux, peuvent travailler en Égypte sans permis de travail.

rule.en: Egypt generally caps foreign staff at 10% of a company's workforce and grants permits only when no qualified Egyptian is available. If you need a work permit, we focus on multinationals and regional offices that hire foreign specialists, and skip public-sector and Egyptians-only roles.
rule.ar: تحدّد مصر عادةً نسبة العاملين الأجانب بـ10% من إجمالي العاملين في الشركة، ولا تمنح تصريح العمل إلا عند عدم توفّر مصري مؤهّل. إذا كنت تحتاج إلى تصريح عمل، نركّز على الشركات متعددة الجنسيات والمكاتب الإقليمية التي توظّف خبراء أجانب، ونستبعد وظائف القطاع العام والوظائف المخصّصة للمصريين فقط.
rule.fr: L'Égypte plafonne en général les salariés étrangers à 10 % des effectifs d'une entreprise et n'accorde de permis que si aucun Égyptien qualifié n'est disponible. Si vous avez besoin d'un permis de travail, nous ciblons les multinationales et les bureaux régionaux qui recrutent des spécialistes étrangers, et écartons les postes du secteur public et ceux réservés aux Égyptiens.

name.fr: Quota de travailleurs étrangers en Égypte

desc.en: As a general rule, foreign staff may make up no more than 10% of an employer's workforce. Each hire needs a Ministry of Labour work permit, granted only when no qualified Egyptian is available, and employers are expected to train Egyptian staff to take over the role.
desc.ar: كقاعدة عامة، لا يجوز أن تتجاوز نسبة العاملين الأجانب 10% من إجمالي العاملين لدى صاحب العمل. ويحتاج كل تعيين إلى تصريح عمل من وزارة العمل لا يُمنح إلا عند عدم توفّر مصري مؤهّل، ويُنتظر من صاحب العمل تدريب عاملين مصريين ليحلّوا محلّ الخبير الأجنبي.
desc.fr: En règle générale, les salariés étrangers ne peuvent dépasser 10 % des effectifs d'un employeur. Chaque recrutement exige un permis de travail du ministère du Travail, accordé seulement si aucun Égyptien qualifié n'est disponible, et l'employeur doit former des salariés égyptiens appelés à reprendre le poste.

sensitive.notes: Egyptian CVs follow the regional Arab format: a professional photo is common and a personal-details block (date of birth, nationality, often marital status, and military status for men) is normal; Wuzzuf profiles and local employer forms ask gender, date of birth and nationality. Nationality also drives the work-permit and foreign-quota logic. Marital status is common on CVs but is not needed to apply and is a bias risk, especially for women, so we do not ask (conservative, same as JO, LY and AE). Military status (موقف التجنيد) is asked of Egyptian men only and has no field in this schema; it does not apply to the female persona, but male Egyptian users will meet it on employer forms. Not verified live this run; see EG.sources.md.

Si vous payez via Fawry ou un portefeuille mobile, chaque renouvellement est un nouveau paiement que vous effectuez vous-même.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Cairo. I lead EAS and IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 30-person finance function. I built the EGP/USD scenario forecasts and Power BI dashboards that helped management protect margins through the currency moves.
bio.ar: محللة مالية بخبرة 8 سنوات في القاهرة. أقود إعداد التقارير المالية وفق معايير المحاسبة المصرية والمعايير الدولية IFRS وإعداد الموازنات على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأتولى الإقفال الشهري لإدارة مالية تضم 30 شخصاً. أعددتُ توقعات بسيناريوهات مختلفة لسعر صرف الجنيه مقابل الدولار ولوحات Power BI ساعدت الإدارة على حماية هوامش الربح خلال تقلبات العملة.
bio.fr: Analyste financière avec 8 ans d'expérience au Caire. Je pilote le reporting selon les normes comptables égyptiennes (EAS) et IFRS ainsi que le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction finance de 30 personnes. J'ai conçu les prévisions par scénarios EGP/USD et les tableaux de bord Power BI qui ont aidé la direction à préserver les marges face aux variations du change.

culture.notes: Work week Sunday to Thursday (Friday-Saturday weekend) in government, banks and most corporates; some private firms also work Saturday, and hours shorten in Ramadan. Pay is quoted monthly and often net, so salary talks should confirm gross or net; payday is end of month by bank transfer, and banks and large firms often pay bonuses or profit share worth several months' salary. Social insurance and income tax are deducted at source. Finance CVs are in English for multinationals, banks and large groups (Arabic for some public bodies), 1-2 pages, often with a photo and a personal-details block (date of birth, nationality, often marital status, and military status for men). A short cover email is usual; formal cover letters mainly at multinationals. Notice: Labour Law No. 12 of 2003 set 2 months (3 months after 10 years' service); the new Labour Law No. 14 of 2025 is in force and its notice rule needs checking, and many contracts set 1-2 months. Arabic is native; English fluency is a key screening point for finance roles. Foreign hiring is limited by the 10% foreign-worker quota. High inflation and the 2024 devaluation make expected-salary questions common on applications, and candidates expect a sizeable raise when they move.
